text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Palmer. There was a packet of 
vegetable seeds on my desk—was that you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's a birthday present! They're 
garlic chive seeds!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, I knew it! Thanks for going out of 
your way! ...Wait, why Chinese chives, 
though?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"You said so yourself, didn't you, 
Ace-san? That you wanted to plant some 
veggies along the edge of the field too."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So when I looked it up, it said Chinese 
chives can grow pretty much anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I've heard that the dirt around the edges 
tends to be hard, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Leave that part to me! Digging in the dirt 
is my specialty♪

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Palmer, you...! Look at you doing 
something so classy! Thanks a lot!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Still... it is my field. It wouldn't be 
right to leave it all to others!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure there were two hoes... 
I'll lend a hand too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait! Then that defeats the whole point of 
a birthday present! Please, just relax and 
rest, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Far as I'm concerned, just knowing you 
care is the best birthday present ever! 
Come on, let's get going!
